newsitem.title: CHINA: Family of China dissident proclaims his innocence.
newsitem.headline: Family of China dissident proclaims his innocence.

text.p: The father of Chinese dissident Wang Dan protested his son's innocence on Wednesday hours before the start of the former student leader's trial, and said the family would not give in to the authorities.
"He is definitely innocent," Wang Xianzeng told reporters as he left his home to go to the court. Wang Dan is being tried on the capital charge of trying to subvert the government.
"It just depends on whether the government wants to convict him or not," Wang told reporters.
"I'm not optimistic about the results... We will definitely appeal... We will not give in," he said.
"Speech can't overthrow the government," he said.
The court charges against Wang say that his writings in foreign media publications are part of evidence to back up the charge that he had tried to overthrow the government.
